title: Between proper and square colorings of planar graphs with maximum degree at most four
summary: An $i$-independent set is a vertex set whose pairwise distance is at least $i+1$. A proper (square) $k$-coloring of a graph $G$ is a partition of its vertex set into $k$ independent ($2$-independent) sets. A packing $(1^{j}, 2^k)$-coloring of a graph $G$ is a partition of $V(G)$ into $j$ independent sets and $k$ $2$-independent sets. It can be viewed as intermediate colorings between proper and square coloring. Wegner conjectured in 1977 that every planar graph with maximum degree at most four is square $9$-colorable.
